opts: You fly for a limited time
2027-03-31.e: Touching the ground refills your jets.

2027-03-31.tag: Chapter 1 · Season X · Out of Time
2027-03-31.q: I'm a cozy little town where fallen stars carrying loot landed. I was the last Named Location added in Chapter 1, and the Black Hole swallowed me 18 days later.
2027-03-31.e: A Legendary Tactical SMG could only be found in one of my stars.

2027-03-31.q: I'm the headquarters of a vehicle mechanic business, with a Green House and a spot called The Love Rock.

2027-03-31.tag: Loot & Lore · Weapons · Guns, blades and launchers
2027-03-31.q: How much faster did the Infinity Blade make you move?
2027-03-31.e: It also gave 200 Health and 200 Shield.
